customers_say: Customers find this smart lock to be of premium quality with smooth functionality and excellent value for money. They appreciate its security features, with one customer highlighting its secure multi-bolt system, and its appearance adds a wow factor to their homes. Customers praise its convenience, with one noting it's particularly helpful for elderly and children, and its versatility with multiple access methods. The battery life receives mixed reviews, with some customers reporting good performance while others mention the battery going dead within a year.
